data.body:
Merged: Gerrit 3416 patch set 2 (fe949b52b47, LLM-Review +1, Verified +1) landed on main as 0445db3b624 via gerrit_safe_submit.py.
Windows evidence: test.yml dispatched on main at 0445db3b624, run 44187054507, job "sweep (windows)" 134406285171. None of the 8 tests/unit/test_reclaim_collapse.py failures from run 44141097601 / 44151162728 recur, and test_reclaim_collapse.py is not in any .github/windows-sweep-deselect/ file, so they ran and passed.
The job itself is still RED with 2 failures that are not in this module: (1) tests/unit/test_unique_cache_writes.py::test_concurrent_cursor_writes_never_report_a_write_error ("a concurrent cursor write was silently dropped: ['reconcile_cursor_write_error']"), which also failed in the earlier scheduled run 44151162728 job 134279570332, so it predates this change; (2) tests/unit/test_crash_guard.py::test_xdist_thread_timeout_names_itself_and_the_test (nested xdist worker "node down: Not properly terminated"), which did not fail in 44151162728. Neither test touches reclaim code.
So this bug's own defect is fixed, but its third criterion as written ("the sweep (windows) job passing") is not met. Leaving the ticket in_progress; not ticking that box. Escalated to the coordinator to decide whether to re-scope that criterion to "no test_reclaim_collapse.py failure in sweep (windows)" or to wait for the two other failures to be fixed under their own tickets (majestic-depilatory-beetle).
